transcript_head: One of the biggest mistakes that guys make when attempting to talk to girls is asking question after question after question. So for example, hey, how are you? What's your name? What are you drinking or where you're from? Do you come here often or at university? What are you studying? What's your major or at a bar? Are you enjoying yourself tonight and so on? It's just question after question. And one of the reasons why that doesn't work is that it doesn't create a two -way connection between you and the woman. Instead, it's a one -way interrogation. And she feels like she's being interrogated. What's with all the questions? Why is this guy continuing to ask me question after question after question? And her guard starts to go up. Additionally, she also gets the sense that the guy doesn't really know what he's doing when it comes to talking to girls. And he's hoping that if he just keeps asking her questions, then something's going to work. Something is going to hit. Something's going to stick. She's going to start saying a lot.
